methods.title: PowerShell collection materialization before pipeline serialization
methods.failure_signature: An inline foreach block is followed directly by a pipeline, producing an empty pipe parser rejection
methods.candidate_workaround: Materialize the foreach result into a scalar collection, then pipe that collection separately
methods.recurrence_guard: Use explicit collection assignment before ConvertTo-Json in long PowerShell one-liners
methods.rollback: Stop before execution on parser rejection; never infer partial copies
methods.scope_boundary: Four exact additive shared reference copies

witnesses.procedure: Serialize a foreach block through an immediately trailing pipe
witnesses.expected: Four exact copies and hash report
witnesses.observed: Parser rejected empty pipe element before execution

witnesses.procedure: Assign foreach rows, then serialize the completed collection
witnesses.expected: Four new destinations with exact source hashes

recommendations.text: Materialize PowerShell collections before piping to serializers, especially after foreach blocks.
